serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Not again…
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhSmile
Big Daddy: Haha! This result is rather unfortunate, but sadly not surprising.
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhNormal
Big Daddy: How about instead of doing this crazy drug, you find a job or hit a gym? Whatever that will make you have more confidence in yourself. There are other ways.
You: I will think about it.
#BigDaddyHurt.Face.bdhSerious
Big Daddy: Mrs. Fisher even told you that this is the quicker way, but you would get the same results with some hard work and patience. Why are you doing this to yourself?
You: If it’s easy and safe why would I bother? Stop trying to get into my head!
